annotations.text:
ChordAdmin redesign — one window, three columns.
The front screen (right) is launch with nothing selected: continue where you left off, batch-analyse new songs as a queue, recent exports, environment at a glance.
Sidebar = the work queue: every song shows its state (empty ring = not analysed, blue dot = analysed, orange pencil = edited since export, green check = exported), with filters. Songs without a YouTube link stay visible, just dimmed.
Inspector tabs: Bar · Tuning · Analysis · Info replace the fixed 280pt diagnostics column.
The 11-stage pipeline becomes a checklist with per-stage timing, inline warnings and Cancel — replacing the colour-capsule badge + raw log console. The log is still there, one disclosure away.
Beat correction goes from blind trial-and-error (each offset click re-ran the whole chart) to a sighted choice: all four pickups drawn over the audio, chart previews live, ⏎ applies.
Export used to write straight to production Firestore from a tiny button. Now it shows exactly what will be overwritten (tempo + sections diff) and keeps a local snapshot for rollback.
